_provenance: Envelope and history-item shape observed live 2026-09-16 against GET /rest/api/3/issue/{key}/changelog on a Jira Cloud test site (907 real changelog entries on the observed issue). Confirmed: the collection is always oldest-first with no orderBy support (an orderBy param sent to this endpoint is silently ignored); startAt/maxResults index that fixed ascending collection directly; total is only trustworthy while the requested startAt does not exceed it -- once startAt overshoots the real total, Jira echoes back total == startAt instead of the real count. A history item's `from`/`to` carry Jira's internal option/user/version IDs -- sometimes null or empty even when a human-readable value exists via fromString/toString (e.g. a Story point estimate change had to: null, toString: "5"; a first Sprint assignment had from: "", fromString: ""). A standard-field item's own fieldId (e.g. status) adds nothing field doesn't already say, and some standard-field items (e.g. an issue-link change with field "Link") omit fieldId entirely; a custom field always carries fieldtype: "custom" and a fieldId like customfield_10020. All tenant, account, and content values below are synthesized.
